pattern.crimePattern: bush-airline owner smothers the senior pilot who grounded an aircraft over a forged inspection, and sits her in the cockpit
pattern.notes: Fictional airline, aircraft registration and inspector. Aviation procedure (logbooks, 100-hour inspections, hour meters, flight plans) is given in outline; the cultural reader and an aviation reader are asked to check it.

ob.text: A bush airline reports one of its pilots, Captain Linda Jepchirchir (36), found slumped dead in the cockpit of her aircraft at Enkare airstrip at 07:40, before the 08:30 shuttle. Suspected medical collapse.

people.name: Captain Linda Jepchirchir
people.bio: Eight years flying the Mara shuttles. Starts every preflight at 06:00 with a pencil tick on line 1.

facts.text: Captain Linda Jepchirchir was found slumped dead in the cockpit of 5Y-MSK at Enkare airstrip at 07:40. Suspected medical collapse.
Cockpit of 5Y-MSK: harness not fastened, headset on its hook, preflight checklist not begun. She always starts at 06:00 with a tick on line 1.
5Y-MSK logbook: a 100-hour inspection in January signed "C. Ndegwa". Linda's red pen across it: "FALSE — aircraft grounded by PIC."
Cornelius Ndegwa: he was in South Africa for all of January (passport stamps) and has never inspected 5Y-MSK.
Silvanus: on Thursday Linda told him, "I won't fly MSK. Fiona can sack me." Rodgers wanted her seniority, he says, "but not like this".
Silvanus: Linda had no offer from another airline. "She was Skylink. She built half of it."
Lodge night log: Silvanus was in the lodge hangar from 19:00 to 06:30, 40 minutes away.
Linda's laptop: a draft report to the aviation authority with photographs of the logbook, saved at 22:47.
Flight plans: Fiona flew Wilson → Enkare on Monday, departing 17:25, landing 18:10. On Tuesday: "Enkare → Enkare, local flight, 06:50–07:28".
Fiona's aircraft hour meter: +0.8 hours since Monday evening's entry. A Nairobi round trip would add about +1.6.
Land Cruiser tracker: cottage to airstrip 05:20–05:35, back at the cottage at 05:50.
Nairobi hotel bill: Rodgers checked in at 19:00 on Monday and out at 07:00 on Tuesday.
Crew payroll: all of Linda's flying hours paid to 31 January.
Crew cottage: the sofa is missing one cushion; the sitting-room rug is gone; the floor has been freshly mopped.
The missing sofa cushion is in the boot of the company Land Cruiser.
Autopsy: smothering. Small burst blood vessels in the eyes; fibres in the nose and mouth.
Autopsy: lividity on her back. She lay flat for hours before being sat upright.
Autopsy: death between 22:45 and 01:00.
Autopsy: no blows or other injuries; no sign of a heart attack; carbon monoxide normal.
Lab: the fibres in her nose and mouth match the cushion from the Land Cruiser's boot.
Toxicology: clean.
Fiona: "I flew in from Nairobi this morning at half past seven."
Fiona: "Linda was overworked. Her heart, probably."
Fiona admits she came in on Monday evening and slept in the owner's room at the cottage, "checking on the staff".
Fiona: "I didn't see Linda all night."
Saruni: "Nobody came to the aircraft all night."
Saruni: he slept in the shelter. He heard a car at about half past five. The boss's plane had been there since Monday evening; she told him not to tell the pilots.
Rodgers: "I was in Nairobi."
Rodgers: "I wanted her job. I'd have got it in two years. I didn't need it today."

interrogations.intro: Fiona stands by her own aircraft in a flying jacket, brisk. "I flew in from Nairobi this morning at half past seven. Linda was overworked. Her heart, probably."

topics.reply: Paperwork errors happen. We would have sorted it out with the authority.

interrogations.intro: Saruni twists his torch in his hands. "Nobody came to the aircraft all night. They were locked."
Rodgers takes the call from Wilson between flights. "I was in Nairobi."

topics.reply: She grounded MSK? Good for her. I wanted her job. I'd have got it in two years. I didn't need it today. My hotel will confirm I was there.

interrogations.intro: Silvanus has driven straight from the lodge, still in his overalls. "She wouldn't fly MSK. She told me on Thursday."

topics.reply: Paid? Every hour, every month. Fiona is many things; she pays.
C. Ndegwa? I rang him myself on Friday. He was in South Africa all January. He'll tell you.

contradictions.reaction: "I slept in the shelter. I heard a car about half past five. And the boss's plane was here since Monday evening. She told me not to tell the pilots. I was afraid to say I was asleep."
Fiona does the arithmetic before you do. "...I came in last night. I slept in the owner's room. I didn't want the staff to know I was checking on them. I didn't see Linda."
Fiona looks at the cushion in its evidence bag. "Thirty-one years," she says. "One signature." She stops talking.

timeOfDeath.note: Alive and writing at 22:47; the autopsy allows 22:45–01:00.

proof.concludes: Linda never began her preflight: she was smothered hours before, lay flat for hours, and was then sat in the seat.
She had grounded 5Y-MSK over a forged inspection and was reporting it to the authority; she was alive at the cottage, saving that report, at 22:47.
Fiona was at Enkare from 18:10 the evening before and slept at the cottage; her "arrival" was a 38-minute circuit, +0.8 on the meter, not +1.6.

The company car carried something from the cottage to the strip at 05:20, and the cushion in its boot carries the fibres from Linda's airway. At the crew cottage, Fiona Gallagher smothered Linda with a cushion and sat her in the cockpit, because she'd grounded the plane and was reporting the faked maintenance records.

eliminations.why: Harness open, headset on its hook, checklist blank, and she lay flat for hours before she was sat there.
She was writing at the cottage at 22:47 and died lying flat, not at the strip.
Saruni slept in the shelter all night; Linda was at the cottage.
Linda was at the cottage at 22:47; nobody flew to Wilson that night.
Saruni slept at the airstrip shelter, with no vehicle and no key to the cottage.
Rodgers was in a Nairobi hotel from 19:00 to 07:00.
Silvanus was in a lodge hangar 40 minutes away all night.
Ndegwa was in Nairobi; he was abroad in January and never inspected MSK.
Smothering, hours before any preflight; no heart attack.
Carbon monoxide normal; the engine never started.
That ambition is Rodgers's, and he was in Nairobi.
She had no offer from another airline.
Saruni sleeping at his post is his failing, not Fiona's motive.

reconstruction.text: Linda finds that 5Y-MSK's logbook shows a January inspection "completed" by an inspector who was abroad all month. She writes FALSE across it, grounds the aircraft and starts a report to the aviation authority.
Monday, 17:25. Facing the loss of her certificate and her biggest contract, Fiona flies in from Wilson and lands at Enkare at 18:10. She tells Saruni not to tell the pilots she's there.
22:47. Linda saves her report. At about 23:00 Fiona comes to the sitting room to persuade her to delete it. Linda refuses. Fiona smothers her with a sofa cushion.

05:20. Fiona drives the company Land Cruiser to the strip and sits Linda in the left seat of MSK, as if she'd collapsed during preflight. The cushion goes in the boot; the rug goes; the floor is mopped.
06:50. Fiona takes off from Enkare, circles for 38 minutes and lands at 07:28, "from Nairobi". At 07:40 she and Saruni find Linda in the cockpit.

ui.beatNotes: Machines that count. The engine hour meter and the flight plan become a small arithmetic puzzle: how many hours would a Nairobi round trip add? The notebook does the sum when the player drags the two together.
